renders_4k.check: Title bar, display and screen corner pass. Fails: garbled glyphs on the CD player buttons, fake text on the taskbar, hole through the dough column
All named fixes pass. Clean play, pause, stop, eject buttons, plain taskbar, solid dough column. One dark speck of a few pixels in the screen's top left corner, Photoshop level

finish_preview.note: Glow matches Mint but the corners and the extended floor go much deeper than Deluge, with dark streaks below and left of the render. Render glow sat at L 86 against a swatch at L 78, and the lightness gamma of 1.74 crushes the falloff. Not committed as a master. Fix finish.py before the real run
